title: Nimble Anklet
content:
# Nimble Anklet

Internal ID: TrinketIronStamina | Type: Trinkets | Source: Forge | Crafting Materials: Iron x5, Withered bone x5, Surtling trophy x1 | Adrenaline Cost: 60 | Effect: 50 stamina gain | +15% movement speed | Duration: 30s

# Introduction

Nimble Anklet is a Swamp-tier trinket.

## Effects

Once 60 Adrenaline has been gained, the Nimble Anklet will trigger automatically, providing 50 stamina immediately, and +15% movement speed for 30 seconds.

Categorias: Trinket
